summary.text: Kristy Janigo is the Democratic candidate for Minnesota State Senate District 37 in the November 3, 2026 general election and the deputy mayor of Maple Grove.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she is an Army National Guard veteran with a Ph.D. who works in local government overseeing and auditing public services.

paragraphs.text: Janigo's Ballotpedia profile lists a bachelor's degree from North Dakota State University in 2005 and a Ph.D. from the University of Minnesota in 2015, and service in the U.S. Army National Guard from 2000 to 2006.
In the survey, she said she grew up in small towns in North Dakota and joined the Army National Guard at 17.
She said she worked for 15 years in the private sector in global manufacturing and then taught for three years in higher education, where she was an academic department chair.

Janigo said she later worked for three years as a veteran advocate and has been a Maple Grove City Council member for four years, and that she also volunteers as a part-time special deputy for the sheriff's water patrol.
She listed affordability, safe communities and trust in government as her top priorities, and named veterans issues and local issues as policy areas she cares about.
She won the August 11, 2026 Democratic primary and said she is the DFL-endorsed candidate.
